questions.question: [What Is Sociology?] Explain the difference between sociology and common sense, using examples.
questions.correctAnswer: Sociology uses systematic research and evidence; common sense relies on untested assumptions. Example: common sense says 'criminals are born'; sociology shows crime is influenced by poverty, socialisation and labelling. Sociology challenges taken-for-granted assumptions.
questions.explanation: Sociology uses systematic research and evidence; common sense relies on untested assumptions. Example: common sense says 'criminals are born'; sociology shows crime is influenced by poverty, socialisation and labelling. Sociology challenges taken-for-granted assumptions.
